同命令同body返回原回执，异体409；来源或配置漂移412；缺映射/不支持的旧消费者422 REQUIRED_OUTPUT_MAPPING；Owner不可得503，无新Baseline。未知提交只查原Freeze命令，不重新Freeze。新读者按Baseline准确固定的两份digest读取；缺一项不返回不完整“全部输出”。这些错误为本适配能力目录的定义，既有封闭错误wire经有版本错误适配投影，不在旧枚举中暗加值。

rows.gap_or_reuse_reason: Existing R1 summary/detail cases and generic overlays cover the principal mechanism, but the pinned bounded revision has more exact field, capacity, canonicalization and recovery conditions; link each condition to an executable observation instead of treating vector count as full coverage.
rows.scenario: 原Baseline事后补关系、Freeze提交后响应丢失、旧consumer缺输出映射、Owner不可得。
rows.required_observation: ENG本地完整同事务后继冻结；原key查回；缺映射422 REQUIRED_OUTPUT_MAPPING、源配置漂移412、异体409、Owner503且无新Baseline；旧封闭wire只经版本化错误适配；REL实际读用证据另列。
rows.owner_scope: Only target responsibility; original OA/ENG providers supply independently verified source facts
